stem: A cart repeatedly rolls into a work aisle because one wheel lock no longer holds. What is the strongest action?
choices: Park it against a wall and continue using it
Remove or tag it out of normal use and route it for repair or replacement according to procedure
Put extra weight on the cart
rationale: A failed restraint creates a predictable struck-by or trip hazard. The defective equipment should be controlled and corrected through the approved process.
